entities.summary: Gil Sharone is an American drummer and member of the rock bands Stolen Babies, Team Sleep, Marilyn Manson and formerly The Dillinger Escape Plan. He was also a fill in for the punk rock supergroup +44. He is the twin brother of Rani Sharone, also of Stolen Babies.
